prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Square reaction-meme image of an absurdly chubby golden-yellow cartoon cat laughing uncontrollably, rendered in soft, glossy 3D animation. Its enormous, broad, almost frog-shaped head merges into a round, pear-shaped body with barely any neck. Small triangular cat ears, a tiny pink nose, cream muzzle, short whiskers, stubby paws, and a thick curling tail make it unmistakably feline. Emphasize the exaggerated laugh: head tilted backward, fat cheeks pushed high, eyes squeezed into curved slits, and an enormous open mouth stretching almost cheek to cheek, with a dark burgundy interior and a rounded pink tongue at the bottom. The swollen cheeks and wide mouth dominate the face; the expression is hilariously goofy, slightly smug, and completely overcome with laughter. Its little forepaws hover beside its belly as its body rocks backward. Smooth rounded shapes, minimal fur detail, saturated buttery yellow, warm soft lighting, gentle shadows. Close, slightly low-angle three-quarter view, with the head filling most of the frame against a simple pale blue background. Prioritize ridiculous facial distortion and instant meme readability over realistic cat anatomy. No text, clothing, accessories, or watermark.
